frieren.emotionGuidance: Frieren is usually composed and emotionally restrained. Strong outward displays like crying or panic are rare unless the scene is clearly intense.

default.emotionGuidance: Default look. Calm emotional range, avoid exaggerated expressions unless scene context is intense.

winter_clothes.emotionGuidance: Winter outfit should still read composed; extreme panic/crying should remain rare.

sleeping_clothes.emotionGuidance: Sleeping outfit implies low-energy scenes; prefer soft, subdued emotions.

fern.emotionGuidance: Fern is generally calm and serious, but she can show irritation in dry, understated ways.

default.emotionGuidance: Default Fern is reserved and controlled.

school_uniform.emotionGuidance: Uniform scenes can be slightly more expressive, but still mostly restrained.

stark.emotionGuidance: Stark tends to wear his feelings openly, so visible shifts between nervousness, determination, and relief are natural for him.

default.emotionGuidance: Default Stark can swing emotions quickly and visibly.

armor.emotionGuidance: Armor scenes bias toward determined/serious readings.
